ruleDefinitions.name: Terminal Service Process Spawn
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a process spawned by the terminal service server process (this could be an indicator for an exploitation of CVE-2019-0708)

sequences.query: (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\svchost\\\.exe.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*termsvcs.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rdpclip\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "None")
